claims.claim: No immediate acquisition when an unexpired refresh token exists and access has less than 25 seconds remaining
claims.qualification: Baseline scheduled an immediate call, but getRefreshToken now reuses credentials beyond three hours. The final lifecycle test explicitly expects no catch-up after hidden return. The claim does not establish a defect or that refresh always fails; the separate refresh-expiry timer may reacquire.

claims.claim: A never-settling pending acquisition prevents automatic recovery expiry and disables Extend
claims.qualification: Axios sets a 60-second timeout. JavaScript suspension, adapter behavior, and production timeout effects are not established. Logout remains available. A bound for wall-clock recovery is unverified.

claims.claim: A refresh credential without usable expiry leads to logout instead of Extend
claims.qualification: Baseline leaves a parsed token with absent exp without an automatic logout timer, but malformed JSON may throw. Final explicitly applies the logout fallback. Token contract and business disposition are not established.

claims.claim: Concurrent session invalidation during delayed logout leaves old prompt loading; logout promise rejection is unhandled
claims.qualification: A focused PEND-10 probe confirms the replacement token remains while the dialog persists, Extend is disabled, and Logout is an enabled no-op. The harness synthesizes the replacement login and keeps Home mounted. Production reachability is unknown. Logout returns void and catches Promise.all rejection.

claims.claim: Cancellation tests do not establish no defect in session controller paths
claims.qualification: Other lifecycle tests also exist. No finite test suite proves no defects; the stale-dialog assertion gap is material.
